title: BBL Aftercare: What to Do After BBL
h1: What to do after BBL laser: aftercare day by day
desc: BBL aftercare: what is normal after BroadBand Light, why spots darken and flake, sun protection, skincare to avoid and when to contact the clinic.
answer: After BBL, skin is usually pink and warm for a few hours. Brown spots darken and look like coffee grounds, then flake off over 5 to 10 days; don't pick them. Use a gentle cleanser and moisturiser, avoid sun, heat and exfoliating products, and wear SPF 50 every day.
body:
## What's normal

- Redness and a sunburn-like warmth for a few hours
- Brown spots turning darker and slightly raised
- Mild swelling, especially after treatment for redness or veins
- Spots flaking off within about a week

## Aftercare

- Cool the skin with a clean, cool compress if it feels warm
- Use a gentle cleanser and a plain moisturiser
- Don't scrub, pick or exfoliate flaking spots
- Avoid saunas, hot showers and intense exercise for 24 to 48 hours
- Mineral make-up is usually fine the next day if the skin is intact

## Sun after BBL

Treated skin is sensitive to sun and can darken. Avoid direct sun for 2 weeks and use SPF 50 daily. See [can I tan before and after BBL?](/blog/bbl-tanning-before-after/)

## When to contact us

Message or call us if you notice blistering, crusting, increasing pain or patches of lighter or darker skin.
faq: Why did my spots get darker after BBL?
That is expected: the pigment rises to the surface before it flakes away.
Usually the next day, if there is no blistering.
